caption: A fluorescent tube in a garage is switched on, and it blinks a few times before staying lit.

sa.check: A fluorescent tube in a garage, dark.
The tube blinks a few times.
The garage is dark before the switch.
The order is dark, switch, blinking, steady.

pc.expect: The tube begins to blink at the switch, and only then.
pc.fail: The switch is thrown and the tube stays dark to the end of the clip; or the tube blinks or glows before the switch is touched; or the tube lights with the switch untouched; or a different lamp lights instead.

pc.expect: The blinking comes first and ends in a steady light that lasts for the rest of the clip; the tube does not go back to blinking or dark.
pc.fail: The tube glows steadily and then starts blinking; or goes dark again after settling; or blinks to the end of the clip without settling; or the steady glow fades out.

pc.expect: The garage lights with the tube: the floor and walls under it brighten with each blink and stay bright once the tube is steady.
pc.fail: The tube glows while the garage stays as dark as before; or the garage brightens while the tube stays dark; or the garage stays lit during a blink's dark phase.

pc.expect: The fixture hangs still through the blinking; nothing in the garage moves at the switch.
pc.fail: The fixture swings at the switch; or tools or objects shift with the blinks; or the door moves by itself.

pc.expect: One tube in one fixture; the fixture stays on the ceiling; the garage's contents are the same before and after.
pc.fail: A second tube appears; or the fixture vanishes or moves; or tools or vehicles appear or vanish between dark and lit frames; or the tube changes length.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The garage's wall colours and contents stay the same apart from brightness.
pc.fail: The walls change colour rather than brightness; or the tools rearrange; or the tube changes colour once steady.
